newsitem.title: USA: Star Multi Care to buy Extended Family.
newsitem.headline: Star Multi Care to buy Extended Family.

text.p: Star Multi Care Services Inc said Monday it agreed to acquire Extended Family Care Corp for $2,400,000 in cash and common valued at $4,850,000.
In a separate statement, Extended Family valued the proposed payment at $0.193 per share, adding it will pay a special dividend of $0.023 per share as part of the the merger agreement.
Star said the merger, expected to be completed by August, will be non-dilutive.

It said Extended Family, formerly Cosmetic Sciences Inc, has annual revenues of $9 million and proforma revenue for the first year of operation after the acquisition is expected to be $62 to $65 million.
Extended Family said the record and payment dates for the special dividend have not been set.
